Steps to Apply
Get your personalized steps to apply
Your steps to apply to IU Indianapolis will depend on the type of application you plan to submit.
Which best describes you?
Please select one
Possible answers
I’m a first year student.
I have not attended college after high school.
I’m transferring to IU Indianapolis.
I attended another university or IU campus. Now I need to transfer to IU Indianapolis as an undergraduate student.
I’m returning to IU Indianapolis.
I want to return to finish my undergraduate degree at IU Indianapolis.
I’m applying to be a graduate or professional student.
I already have a bachelor’s degree and I’m pursuing graduate or professional level education.
I just want to take undergraduate courses.
I want to enroll in undergraduate level coursework without declaring a degree at this time.
I just want to take graduate courses.
I possess a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution and want to take only graduate-level courses without declaring a degree program.
I want to earn a second bachelor's degree.
I have a bachelor's degree and would like to earn another.
Are you a domestic or international student?
Please select one
Possible answers
I am a domestic student
I reside permanently in the United States as a US Citizen, Permanent Resident, Undocumented or DACA student, Asylee, or Refugee
I am an international student
I reside permanently outside the United States and require a nonimmigrant visa (e.g., F-1, J-1, H1-B, H-4, L-2, etc.)

Step #
Apply to IU
With Apply IU, you can apply to IU Indianapolis and other IU campuses with one application. You can also complete the Common Application, which allows you to apply to IU Indianapolis plus 900+ other colleges and universities. Please submit only one application, as multiple submissions may cause processing delays.
There is a $65 nonrefundable application fee that you will pay while applying. If you choose Apply IU, you'll be able to enter your waiver code or request a waiver code. If you served in the U.S. military or are a U.S. veteran, you can request a veteran fee waiver.

Step #
Honors College application (optional)
All incoming freshmen who apply to the Honors College will be considered for both admission and four-year scholarship opportunities, and students may apply for one or more of our four competitive scholarship programs.
To be eligible to apply for admission and scholarships, you must have a minimum cumulative high school GPA of a 3.75 or higher.
Deadline(s):
Priority scholarship deadline: November 15 | Regular deadline: February 1st

Deadline(s):

More about ECE reports

Step #
Review eligibility for admissions-based scholarships
Admissions-based scholarships are available for Transfer students and are renewable for a maximum of two years, or four total semesters, automatically, as long as all eligibility requirements are met. TRU ABS award given to all domestic transfer students (non-international) with a minimum college GPA of 3.5 and a minimum 26 external transfer credits earned.
In order to remain eligible for this scholarship, you must
• maintain full-time enrollment for the fall and spring terms,
• earn a minimum of 24 credits, and
• have a minimum GPA of 3.0.
